outcome.answer: Several papers study medical knowledge graphs with clinical LLMs. [2] presents MM-KG, which links multimodal patient evidence to biomedical concepts and retrieves relevant subgraphs for LLM use. [1] compares methods for integrating biomedical KG signals into LLM training, reporting that KG-judgment training with KL regularization produces sparse model updates and improves reasoning quality. [3] finds that KG grounding helps clinical question answering when the decisive fact is outside the model’s training, but adds little for known facts. [5] and [6] focus on evidence-traceable and temporal knowledge graphs for clinical reasoning. [9] compares incorporating UMLS knowledge through continual pretraining with GraphRAG at inference time.
